/-- The `n`th Taylor polynomial of `log` at `1`, as a function `ℂ → ℂ` -/
noncomputable
def logTaylor (n : ℕ) : ℂ → ℂ := fun z ↦ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, (-1) ^ (j + 1) * z ^ j / j
